cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team at Actief Interim Oostkamp,

I am applying for the Warehouse Worker night shift position at the logistics company in Oostkamp. As a Belgian resident with my own transport, I meet the practical requirements and am ready to start immediately.

My background includes hands-on warehouse work at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, where I maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment. This experience taught me the importance of reliable loading and unloading, quality checks, and keeping the workspace organised and safe. I am comfortable working in cold environments and specifically want to work night shifts, as I perform best during those hours. I can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) and am keen to take advantage of your internal reach truck training to expand my skills.

While my recent roles have been in digital marketing, the skills I developed there—attention to detail, following procedures, and working efficiently under pressure—are directly transferable to warehouse operations. I am fluent in English, which is fully accepted in your workplace, and I am committed to building a long-term career in logistics. The offer of a permanent contract after a successful interim period, along with the stable sector and year-round work, aligns perfectly with my goal of job security.

I am excited about the opportunity to join your team and contribute to the distribution of frozen food products across Belgium and Europe. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your operations.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
